legenda: Brazilian samba-rock and samba soul, joyful black dance hall groove, confident and warm mood, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese, punchy brass section with trumpets and trombone, wah-wah electric guitar, funky slap bass, cuica, cowbell, tambourine and hand claps, Rhodes piano, call and response horns, vintage seventies baile feel, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: As radiografias panorâmicas que o Gian tria com a especialista de Porto Alegre viram baile de samba-rock, com o siso inferior abrindo a pista.
descricao: Samba-rock com metais e cuíca sobre o Dentia, que lê radiografias panorâmicas e vê o siso dançar a noventa e quatro por cento.
